narrative_purpose: Open the chapter on the absence the whole argument turns on: seen from directly underneath, this enormous flying animal has no wings anywhere and is visibly not pushing on the air.
subject: Looking straight up at a vast translucent pale dome filling almost the entire frame, seen from below so its underside is visible: a broad soft organic bell with faint radiating internal structures showing through the translucent wall, a ring of thick muscle banding around its lower rim, and a dense curtain of long thin tentacles hanging down toward the viewer. Woven fibre harness bands cross the underside, holding two small wicker-and-hide platforms with tiny blue-skinned figures on them.
scene: Directly beneath the creature as it passes overhead, a sliver of open sky and one distant ridge visible at the edges of the frame beyond the dome's rim.
camera: Extreme low angle looking vertically upward, the dome in near-silhouette against bright sky, strong sense of scale and mass overhead.
light: Backlit from above so the dome glows translucent where the sky shines through it, the harness and platforms in cool shadow beneath.
palette: Pale luminous cyan and mist where light passes through the membrane, deep teal-indigo in the shadowed underside and tentacles.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, awed and observational.
detail_level: Crisp on the muscle band, harness weave and nearest tentacles; the dome's far rim softens into glare and haze.
composition: The dome filling the upper and central frame, tentacle curtain descending through the lower third, one plain dark region of open sky at the frame edge framed by deep negative space.
consistency_notes: The teaching point is the TOTAL ABSENCE of wings or any flapping surface. Keep a plain dark area of open sky at one edge so callouts can be overlaid later. Same creature design as fig-00-cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no wings, no feathers, no metal frame, no propellers, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
